title: BBQ Chicken Pizza with Red Onion and Lime Soured Cream
changes_from_base: Roasted, shredded chicken thighs tossed in barbecue sauce and coriander replace the tomato sauce, red onion and a Monterey Jack and cheddar mix go on top, and a lime and coriander soured cream is drizzled over at the end.
summary: Barbecued chicken pizza with caramelised red onion, two melted cheeses and a cool, zingy lime soured cream drizzle that balances the spice.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 30 x 40 cm

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
extra-virgin olive oil, for the tray and brushing
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature

steps.title: Roast Chicken
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C, toss chicken (500 g) with oil (15 ml), salt (½ tsp) and pepper (¼ tsp) in a roasting tin and roast 20-25 min until it reaches 74 °C, cool slightly and shred.

steps.title: Make Chicken Mixture
steps.text: Mix the shredded chicken with barbecue sauce (120 ml) and coriander (2 tbsp chopped).

steps.title: Prepare Onion
steps.text: Toss the sliced red onion (½ onion) with oil (15 ml), salt (¼ tsp) and pepper (¼ tsp).

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Raise the oven to 260 °C with a shelf in the upper-middle and brush the tray with 30 ml oil.

steps.title: Shape and Bake
steps.text: Roll the dough (450 g) on a floured worktop to an oval about 40 x 23 cm and 6 mm thick, lift onto the tray, brush with the last 30 ml oil and bake about 6 min until it puffs and starts to colour.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Scatter the chicken mixture over, then the onion, bake about 10 min until the onion browns, scatter Monterey Jack (60 g grated) and cheddar (55 g grated) and bake about 5 min until melted.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Whisk soured cream (120 g), lime juice (30 ml) and remaining coriander (2 tbsp), drizzle over the hot pizza and serve the rest alongside.

tips: Cooking the chicken first to 74 °C means it only needs gentle heating on the pizza, keeping the meat juicy whilst the toppings develop colour
Make the lime soured cream just before serving so it stays cold and doesn't separate from the residual heat of the pizza
Check the barbecue sauce label: many contain gluten, mustard or celery.
storage: Cool completely, then keep chilled for up to 2 days and reheat gently in a foil-covered tin in a low oven until hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
